description:
Convert a Word document (.docx) to a valid EPUB3 ebook. Chapters split on the document's top heading level (Heading 1 in a normal manuscript), or on page breaks, or not at all. Keeps bold/italic, lists, tables, inline images (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP), hyperlinks and footnotes; reads the title and author from the document's properties. No Pandoc, no Calibre.

Free tier: 5MB/file (10MB for pdf-to-epub, 15MB for split), 3 operations/day, 15 req/min, output includes Epublys branding.
Pro ($9/mo): 30MB per operation, unlimited daily operations, 60 req/min, no branding.

When a call is refused with daily_limited or a Pro-only error, call the `upgrade_to_pro` tool — it returns a checkout link to hand the user. Details: https://epublys.com/pricing

name.description: Original filename — used as the title fallback; the output is named after its stem

title.description: Book title (defaults to the document title, then its first heading)
